using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.ProjectModification;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Utils;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.ProjectModification.Tests;

public class ProjectNpmPackageAdderTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<ProjectNpmPackageAdder>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly Mock<ICmdHelper> _mockCmdHelper;
    private readonly Mock<IDirectoryHelper> _mockDirectoryHelper;
    private readonly ProjectNpmPackageAdder _adder;

    public ProjectNpmPackageAdderTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ProjectNpmPackageAdder>>();
        _mockCmdHelper = new Mock<ICmdHelper>();
        _mockDirectoryHelper = new Mock<IDirectoryHelper>();

        // Mock other dependencies as Null objects or minimal mocks
        var jsonSerializer = new Mock<IJsonSerializer>().Object;
        var sourceCodeDownloadService = new Mock<SourceCodeDownloadService>().Object;
        var angularSourceCodeAdder = new Mock<AngularSourceCodeAdder>().Object;
        var remoteServiceExceptionHandler = new Mock<IRemoteServiceExceptionHandler>().Object;
        var installLibsService = new Mock<IInstallLibsService>().Object;
        var cliHttpClientFactory = new Mock<CliHttpClientFactory>().Object;
        var npmPackageInfoProvider = new Mock<INpmPackageInfoProvider>().Object;

        _mockCmdHelper.SetupAllProperties();

        _adder = new ProjectNpmPackageAdder(
            jsonSerializer,
            sourceCodeDownloadService,
            angularSourceCodeAdder,
            remoteServiceExceptionHandler,
            installLibsService,
            _mockCmdHelper.Object,
            cliHttpClientFactory,
            npmPackageInfoProvider
        )
        {
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object
        };

        // Mock DirectoryHelper static methods
        DirectoryHelper.ChangeCurrentDirectory = (Func<string, IDisposable>)_mockDirectoryHelper.Object.Dispose;
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddNpmPackageAsync_Should_Log_YarnAddCommand_When_Package_Not_Present()
    {
        // Arrange
        var directory = "/test/project";
        var npmPackage = new NpmPackageInfo { Name = "@abp/theme-shared" };
        var packageJsonPath = Path.Combine(directory, "package.json");

        // Create temp package.json without the package
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(packageJsonPath, "{}");

        _mockCmdHelper.Setup(x => x.RunCmd(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(0);

        // Act
        await _adder.AddNpmPackageAsync(directory, npmPackage);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("yarn add @abp/theme-shared")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddNpmPackageAsync_Should_Log_YarnAddCommand_WithVersion_When_Package_Not_Present_And_Version_Specified()
    {
        // Arrange
        var directory = "/test/project";
        var npmPackage = new NpmPackageInfo { Name = "@abp/theme-shared" };
        var version = "1.2.3";
        var packageJsonPath = Path.Combine(directory, "package.json");

        // Create temp package.json without the package
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(packageJsonPath, "{}");

        _mockCmdHelper.Setup(x => x.RunCmd(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(0);

        // Act
        await _adder.AddNpmPackageAsync(directory, npmPackage, version);

        // Assert - should log "yarn add @abp/theme-shared@1.2.3"
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("yarn add @abp/theme-shared@1.2.3")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddNpmPackageAsync_Should_Log_AlreadyInstalled_When_Package_Present()
    {
        // Arrange
        var directory = "/test/project";
        var npmPackage = new NpmPackageInfo { Name = "@abp/theme-shared" };
        var packageJsonPath = Path.Combine(directory, "package.json");

        // Create temp package.json WITH the package
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(packageJsonPath, "{\"dependencies\":{\"@abp/theme-shared\":\"1.0.0\"}}");

        // Act
        await _adder.AddNpmPackageAsync(directory, npmPackage);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("'@abp/theme-shared' is already installed.")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddMvcPackageAsync_Should_Log_YarnAddCommand()
    {
        // Arrange
        var directory = "/test/project";
        var npmPackage = new NpmPackageInfo { Name = "@abp/mvc-package" };
        var packageJsonPath = Path.Combine(directory, "package.json");

        // Create temp package.json without the package
        await File.WriteAllTextAsync(packageJsonPath, "{}");

        _mockCmdHelper.Setup(x => x.RunCmd(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(0);

        // Act
        await _adder.AddMvcPackageAsync(directory, npmPackage);

        // Assert - covers the LogInformation call in AddMvcPackageAsync
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("yarn add @abp/mvc-package")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }
}
